solution.title: Windows Endpoint Performance & Reliability Troubleshooting (Boot, Profile, Crash, Disk)

products.name: Windows Endpoint Performance & Reliability Troubleshooting (Boot, Profile, Crash, Disk) — Commercial
products.short_description: A measure-first root-cause method and scripts for Windows performance and reliability — boot, profile, crashes, resource pressure, and disk health — turning “it's slow” into a measured cause and fix. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn a slow, crashing PC into a measured, fixed one

“My computer is slow” is the ticket no one can quantify — slow boot, sign-in delays, crashes, disk pressure, or a runaway process. This toolkit gives you a measure-first root-cause method and diagnostic scripts for Windows performance and reliability in an enterprise fleet, so you turn a vague complaint into a measured cause (boot phase, profile load, resource pressure, crash/bugcheck, storage health) and a targeted fix.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the performance/reliability model (boot → sign-in/profile → steady-state resource use → stability), the signals to measure, and the root-cause tree.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need (endpoint access, Intune Endpoint analytics where available, event/log access) with how to verify each.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (slow boot, slow sign-in/profile, high CPU/RAM/disk, crashes/bugchecks, storage/SSD health) with the exact measurements and checks per branch.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — performance/reliability discovery, per-device measurement validation, a fleet performance/reliability report, safe remediation of common causes (startup, temp, profile), and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with measured pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices for baselining and repeatable performance triage.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A slow or crashing endpoint turned into a measured cause and a targeted fix — with a repeatable, evidence-based method and scripts you keep and reuse.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WINPERF-Discovery.ps1 — quick read-only sweep of Windows performance and reliability signals
    • WINPERF-Remediation.ps1 — safe, reversible fixes for common performance causes (default preview)
    • WINPERF-Report.ps1 — fleet-wide performance and reliability roll-up from collected results
    • WINPERF-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/populate a pilot Entra group via Graph (default preview)
    • WINPERF-Validation.ps1 — deep per-device measurement scored against the pass/fail gates

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
